title: Census facts read only from archive captures go UNK, and answers that cite gone sources lose their DOC tag
goal: each 2026-10-21 census source recorded confirmed from an Internet Archive capture (S1425, S-nwnif62g, S-uzuvf3vo) is recorded gone with its facts re-tagged UNK and a dated note of what was tried, security/baselines-catalog.csv no longer calls them current, and every kb/public/_answers.md line whose DOC tag cites only sources the census records gone (QS10, QS12 and the version-pin answer) carries the tag its article now gives

run: import csv,re,sys;out={r['id']:r['outcome'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv',encoding='utf-8'))};bad=[str(n)+':'+','.join(ids) for n,l in enumerate(open('kb/public/_answers.md',encoding='utf-8'),1) for t in re.findall(r'\[DOC ([^\]]+)\]',l) for ids in [re.findall(r'S-?[a-z0-9]+',t.split(':')[0])] if ids and all(out.get(i)=='gone' for i in ids)];print('DOC tags citing only gone sources:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
